context.transcript:
Hi, J-Min.
I know you missed the meeting yesterday to tour the new factory, but there was a presentation on the quarterly report.
Did you have a chance to review it?
Yes, I did.
It was a great report.
I agree.
We're producing more automobiles than ever before.
I'm especially happy that we hit a peak of 387,000 units.
Yes, that was the highlight of the presentation.
I was also encouraged because production costs should fall significantly next year.
Our raw material suppliers are lowering prices.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，J-Min。
我知道你昨天错过了参观新工厂的会议，但关于季度报告的演示已经进行了。
你有机会回顾了吗？
是的，我有。
这是一份很棒的报告。
我同意。
我们的汽车产量比以往任何时候都多。
我特别高兴我们达到了387,000辆的峰值。
是的，这是演示的亮点。
我也感到鼓舞，因为明年生产成本应该会显著下降。
我们的原材料供应商正在降低价格。
